Compliance Answer: Funds received or held by an independent clearing house for maintaining insurance, guarantee, compensation funds are deducted from CET1 capital as trust property under the Financial Institutions (Protection of Funds) Act.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 49(2)(b), Financial Institutions (Protection of Funds) Act, Chapter 504 of Title II of Part X of The Banking and Insurance Administration Ordinance [Cap. 504]
3. Explanation: Under the regulatory context provided by Section 49(2)(b) of the Financial Institutions (Protection of Funds) Act, funds held or received for maintaining insurance and guarantee purposes are considered trust property which can be deducted from Common Equity Tier 1 capital.
